data_source: TCGA via FireBrowse standardized data (release 2016-01-28): matched mRNA-seq (RSEM, upper-quartile normalized) and miRNA-seq (RPM); GBM and LAML excluded
feature_filter_rule: top 5,000 mRNAs (of 20,289) and top 200 miRNAs (of 1,146) by variance across all 8,890 samples
transform: mRNA: log2(10 + RSEM normalized count); miRNA: log2(1 + RPM)
pair_selection: all 5,000 x 200 = 1e+06 pairs of the high-variance domain
notes: sampleType in matchedNoGBM.rda: 7924 tumor, 588 normal, 378 metastasis (all used, as in the paper)

data_source: GTEx v8 via UCSC Xena TCGA-TARGET-GTEx expression matrix (log2(TPM + 0.001)); tissue = SMTSD field of GTEx_Analysis_v8_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt joined on sample ID
feature_filter_rule: 1,500 most variable genes (of 19,069) among the 4,962 samples of the 20 retained tissues
min_context_size_rule: >= 150 samples per tissue, 20 largest tissues kept
pair_selection: 200,000 unordered gene pairs sampled uniformly without replacement from 1,124,250 possible (seed 1)
notes: 27 of 7792 Xena samples have no SMTSD match; 21 tissues have >= 150 samples, the 21st (Colon - Transverse, n = 164) is dropped by the 20-tissue cap; 1104 of the 1,500 genes are shared between the two candidate variance rankings (see gtex_convention_grid.csv)

data_source: 10x Genomics PBMC 3k (single healthy donor; Cell Ranger 1.1.0, hg19): 2,700 cells x 32,738 genes; local copy sc_inputs/pbmc_scrna.rds
feature_filter_rule: 1,655 genes: top 2,000 highly variable genes (Seurat vst) plus 61 marker genes, detected in >= 1% of cells, capped at 1,800
transform: QC: >= 200 detected genes and <= 20% mitochondrial UMIs; Seurat LogNormalize (UMI / cell total x 1e4, log1p)
pair_selection: 200,000 gene pairs sampled without replacement from 1,368,685 unordered pairs (seed 100)
notes: coarse cell types by marker-gene scoring assigned before correlation analysis; labels with < 200 cells excluded from the analysis population: DC (n = 25), Other (n = 4), Platelet (n = 15)

data_source: 10x Genomics PBMC 10k with TotalSeq-B antibodies (pbmc_10k_protein_v3, Cell Ranger v3 filtered_feature_bc_matrix): 7,865 cells x 33,538 genes + 17 antibody-derived tags; local copy sc_inputs/pbmc_citeseq.rds
feature_filter_rule: 14 ADTs (17 minus 3 isotype controls) x 1,055 genes (top 1,500 highly variable genes plus marker panel, detected in >= 1% of cells, capped at 1,300)
transform: QC on RNA: >= 200 detected genes and <= 20% mitochondrial UMIs; RNA Seurat LogNormalize; ADT centered log-ratio per cell (Seurat CLR, margin 2)
notes: contexts = Seurat weighted-nearest-neighbor (WNN) joint RNA+ADT Louvain clusters (resolution 0.6): 20 clusters; the 9 clusters with < 200 cells (996 cells) are excluded from the analysis population

data_source: TCGA BRCA primary tumors from the matched set (n = 753); PAM50 call from UCSC Xena BRCA_clinicalMatrix (PAM50Call_RNAseq)
feature_filter_rule: top 5,000 mRNAs and top 200 miRNAs by variance within the 753 BRCA primary tumors
transform: mRNA: log2(10 + RSEM normalized count); miRNA: log2(1 + RPM)
notes: excluded from within-context statistics and from the analysis population: Normal (n = 16)

data_source: TCGA BRCA primary tumors from the matched set (n = 753); ER/PR/HER2 status from UCSC Xena BRCA_clinicalMatrix (ER_Status_nature2012, PR_Status_nature2012, HER2_Final_Status_nature2012)
feature_filter_rule: top 5,000 mRNAs and top 200 miRNAs by variance within the 753 BRCA primary tumors
transform: mRNA: log2(10 + RSEM normalized count); miRNA: log2(1 + RPM)
